title: Market Intel Content Frame v2
description: Additive structure layered on top of the REAL production content_frames table (18 columns as of 2026-07-07: id, created_at, frame_text, frame_type, target_segment, target_context, keyword, tone, channel, publish_date, engagement_score, likes, comments, shares, post_url, is_starred, star_note, performance_data — verified via Supabase MCP, see docs/ADR/2026-07-07-market-intel-signals-schema.md 'Production Baseline Correction'). This schema describes the 4 NEW additive columns only: signals, positioned_content, ai_summary, collector_version. Adds 9 independently-queryable signal dimensions, traceable evidence per signal, and an explicit link from positioned_content back to the signals that produced it.

metadata.description: Who/what/where this frame came from. IMPORTANT — corrected 2026-07-07: 'area' and 'source_type' below are NOT dedicated columns in the real content_frames table. Per the ISSUE-007 fix (memory/n8n-workflows/Finnhouses — Market Intelligence Collector v1 (2).json), area/timing/source info is currently folded into the composite `target_context` TEXT column (e.g. 'บางนา | timing:bonus | source:manual'), and there is no dedicated source_type column at all (the real columns are `frame_type` and `channel`). This metadata object is therefore a LOGICAL grouping for this JSON Schema's own signals/positioned_content fields, not a 1:1 map to real columns — Phase 3 must decide whether to parse area back out of target_context, or carry it redundantly inside the new `signals`/`positioned_content` JSONB until/unless a dedicated `area` column is added in a future migration.

area.description: NOT a real column today — see description above. Populate from target_context parsing or duplicate here inside positioned_content/signals until a dedicated column exists.

property_type.description: e.g. 'townhome', 'single_detached', 'land' — not a real column either; same caveat as area.

buyer_segment.description: Maps to the real `target_segment` column, which already exists and is already written correctly by the Collector.

source_type.description: NOT a real column. Real columns are `frame_type` (default 'fb_post') and `channel` (default 'facebook') — those already capture most of what this field was meant for. Kept here for the manual-observation vs facebook_post distinction until reconciled with frame_type/channel in Phase 3.

source_ref.description: Post ID / URL / message ID this frame was extracted from, for traceability back to raw source. No existing column for this — new information, not currently captured anywhere.

collector_version.description: Real column, added by the Phase 2 migration (2026-07-07) with DEFAULT 'v1'. All 75 pre-existing rows now read 'v1'. New rows written by the Phase-3-updated Collector should explicitly set 'v2'.

signals.description: 9 independent dimensions. Each MUST use the shared signal shape below so they stay queryable and comparable (e.g. filter WHERE signals->urgency->>level = 'high' AND signals->liquidity->>level = 'low'). See ADR Implementation Notes for the rubric that keeps urgency / seller_motivation / liquidity from bleeding into each other.

demand.description: Buyer interest level for this property/area (inquiry volume, view count, comment activity)

price.description: Price positioning vs comparable listings (over/under/at-market) — NOT the raw price number, that lives in metadata/raw payload if needed

liquidity.description: AREA-LEVEL aggregate: how fast properties in this area typically sell. NOT derivable from a single post's text — see ADR. source_scope MUST be 'area_aggregate'.

offer.description: Concessions/incentives present in the listing (free furniture, price includes transfer fee, negotiable, etc.)

finance.description: Financing signals (loan-ready, bank rejection mentioned, cash-buyer-only, rent-to-own offered)

value.description: Perceived value-for-money framing used in the listing itself (renovated, corner unit, extra land, etc.)

location.description: Locational advantage signals explicitly called out (near BTS, school zone, main road access)

urgency.description: SURFACE signal from the post text itself — explicit urgency language or an explicit deadline. Keyword/phrase-detectable. source_scope = 'post'.

seller_motivation.description: INFERRED reason behind urgency (relocation, debt, inheritance sale, upgrading) — requires contextual inference beyond keyword matching, not just urgency restated. source_scope = 'post'.

positioned_content.description: The marketing angle derived from the signals above. signal_refs makes the link explicit so prompt/model changes can be debugged against which signals actually drove which hook.

hook.description: Replaces the old 'keyword'/'positioned_hook' field — the actual content angle text

signal_refs.description: Which signal keys this hook was derived from, e.g. ["urgency", "value"]

channel.description: Intended output channel: facebook_post, blog, line_broadcast

example_copy.description: Optional draft copy for the channel above

ai_summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable synthesis for the dashboard, kept separate from the raw signals so the dashboard doesn't need to re-derive prose from structured data every render.

model.description: e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'claude-sonnet' — for the AI cost/audit trail per AI_TEAM.md section 9

signal.description: Shared shape for every signal dimension. {level, confidence, evidence} is mandatory so nothing is a bare string/boolean that can't be traced back to source.

level.description: null + confidence 0 means 'insufficient data', not 'low' — important for liquidity before an area has enough historical volume

score.description: Optional numeric alternative to level for sorting/ranking; not required if level is sufficient

evidence.description: Verbatim snippet(s) from source text (or, for liquidity, the aggregate stat used) that justify this level — required for every non-null level, ties back to Phase 3 self-improving loop in HANDOFF.md

source_scope.description: post = derived from this single listing's text by the LLM at ingestion time. area_aggregate = computed by the Hub from historical rows for the same area, not per-post. Only 'liquidity' should ever be area_aggregate.

rubric_note.description: Which rubric rule fired, for prompt debugging — e.g. 'explicit_urgency_keyword: ด่วน' vs 'inferred_reason: relocation'
